text:
Good job Salman for finding a lab interested in printing the spider. I would say it's definitely worth looking into that option further and potentially give it a try.

However, it would be good to know more about the kind of collaboration they expect, and have Romain R look into that (what's the lab, what's the team, who's your contact, what do they expect, what's their 3D printing expertise)?
Also, as Thi-Mai already experienced, you might want to check their printer(s) have a large enough printing area.

By the way, what's the status of the La Paillasse 3D printer (Fly lab) ? I suspect we might have to test and try a little, and I anticipate using an onsite printer allowing us to do multiple tests quickly a real plus.

ONE MORE THING : The LED Brain to print ! :heart_eyes:
<http://www.thingiverse.com/thing:620846>

attachments.title: LED-Lit Brain by Djholt
attachments.text: A full-scale replica of a human brain (modeled from an anatomical MRI scan) mounted on a printable stand, featuring LED lights installed within each of the three supports. We want to see one printed using glow-in-the-dark filament. If you print one, send pictures. If you happen to have an MRI scanner handy, or want to participate in a study at your local university, then it might be easier than you think to print a replica of your own brain instead.

Thanks for your timely response <@U04T6ATLX> :simple_smile:

     Concerning your queries..
- At this point, I don't know about what kind of collaboration can happen - as it'll depend on where our discussion will lead to us. Now, the lab is 'EPITECH Innovation HUB' which is a joint venture being operated by 'IONIS Education Group'. The students can work here on their start-ups, academic projects, state-funded projects etc and can also have the access of different sophisticated tools (hologram devices, robotics, 3D printers, etc - to name a few). Also, the Lab is being managed by a group of 'Alumni Students' who are always here to supervise/guide you under crucial circumstances.
- They have two 3D printers and also a dedicated guy who looks after them. I don't have any idea about the capacity/ or specs, but I have sent them the link of the 3D file, upon which they didn't raise any questions and were ready to print it out.
     Now, concerning the meeting - I've just talked with the guy (who is my contact person) and confirmed the meeting on 14th (Monday) at 6pm/7pm (they will be here on both of these slots).
